blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Mandaluyong regional trial court dismissed a petition for indirect contempt filed against several members of the Lopez majority bloc over alleged violations of a temporary retraining order linked to the controversial family feud. On Wednesday, Lopez Holdings Corp. said in a regulatory filing that it submitted a copy of the Oct. 26 court ruling granting the respondents’ joint motion to dismiss the complaint with prejudice.
